title: GUARD (fixed in 6566f5a559) — was: a `completer` style naming a function that does not exist: zsh reports it, zshrs ignores it

retired.fix_commit_subject: fix(compsys): _main_complete cites line 214 for an undefined completer
retired.why: The recorded 2026-08-30 shape (no diagnostic at all, plus the cc_match_set listing) had already been fixed elsewhere: the port gained the command-not-found diagnostic and the match set converged. What still diverged on every cell was the line number in that diagnostic: the bundled _main_complete is upstream master's (vendor/zsh/functions/_main_complete since 9b0a504806), where `elif "$tmp"; then` is sh:214, and the oracle prints `_main_complete:214: command not found: _fasd_zsh_word_complete_trigger`; the port hardcoded 5.9.2's 218 in the eprintln and in set_sh_lineno. 6566f5a559 changes both to 214.
retired.evidence: re-verified first-hand with scripts/compsys_regressions.py --only completer_style_missing_function --variants against a pinned copy of the fixed build: the unflipped fixture scored NOW-PASSES for the cell, variant0 and variant1 on two separate runs (one with --confirm-moved 1: NOW-PASSES -> NOW-PASSES each). With expect flipped to agrees, three runs each scored 3 CONTROL-HOLDS.

observed.notes: both shells print `_main_complete:214: command not found: _fasd_zsh_word_complete_trigger` above the same `files` listing, on the cell and both variants.

observed_when_diverging.fingerprint_label: cell/row0/col0 | ref/$ CC _main_complete:#: command not found: _fasd_zsh_word_complete_trigger | test/$ CC

rows.zshrs: bench/        daemon/       editors/      man/          src/          test_corpus/  typeset.tmp/

observed_when_diverging.notes: Two names in the chain do not exist on this host (_megacomplete and _fasd_zsh_word_complete_trigger). zsh runs the chain far enough to hit the missing function and prints 'command not found'; zshrs silently skips it. The match-set half of the difference is fixture cc_match_set showing through — the diagnostic is what is new here.

variants.note: confirmed 2026-08-30 (FAIL, 3 rows, fingerprint 7b20398e3e): same missing-function diagnostic, plus the tag list in the format line differs — zsh '`input files', `files', or `last args'' vs zshrs '... `fasd ranked files', `fasd ranked directories', ...'.
confirmed 2026-08-30 (FAIL, 3 rows, fingerprint 2c3fbfd907): with a ctrl-g abort after the tab, zsh leaves 'CC   ib' plus the diagnostic, zshrs leaves the inserted match 'CC   bench'.
